title: Management- Manage authorizations
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2025-05-06
html:
Introduction

The Shop Management page is where partners can view and manage all their authorizations with sellers.

Guide

Once the seller has authorized Apps or Services, DTSP will be able to check and manage authorization on the Seller Management - Manage Authorize page Tips: Partners can use the filters below to locate specific authorizations. eg authorization ID, service name, shop name/code/id If one seller has renewed the authorization with TSP, TSP will be able to check the seller's extended authorization on the authorization list page as below. By clicking "View More", Partner can check the authorization under “Related Authorization".

Status of service

Status Terminology Definition
Active Your authorization with the seller is active.
Completed Your authorization with the seller has expired.
Authorization Canceled You have canceled your authorization from the seller.
Closed Your authorization with the seller has been deactivated.
